missions.title: Unplug for 1 Hour
missions.description: Turn off and unplug non-essential devices for one hour today.

missions.title: Lights Off Evening
missions.description: Use lights only in rooms you are inside for an entire evening.

missions.title: Walk or Cycle Instead
missions.description: Replace one short car ride with walking, cycling, or public transport today.

missions.title: Choose a Fan Over AC
missions.description: Use a fan or natural ventilation instead of air conditioning for at least two hours.

missions.title: Use a Reusable Bottle
missions.description: Avoid all single-use plastic bottles today by using a reusable bottle.

missions.title: Sort 5 Waste Items
missions.description: Find 5 items and sort them correctly into recycling, compost, or trash.

missions.title: No Impulse Buys
missions.description: Avoid unnecessary online or in-store purchases for the entire day.

missions.title: Fix or Repurpose an Item
missions.description: Repair or creatively reuse something you were planning to throw away.

missions.title: Eat a Plant-Based Meal
missions.description: Have at least one fully plant-based meal today.

missions.title: Shorter Shower Challenge
missions.description: Reduce your shower time by at least 3 minutes to save water.

missions.title: Turn Off the Tap
missions.description: Brush your teeth while keeping the tap off except when rinsing.

missions.title: Check for Leaks
missions.description: Inspect your home for dripping taps or leaks and report them if found.

missions.title: Screen Break Day
missions.description: Take three 10-minute breaks away from screens today.

missions.title: Move for 20 Minutes
missions.description: Do at least 20 minutes of physical activity—walking, stretching, dancing, anything!

missions.title: Check In on Someone
missions.description: Reach out to someone and ask how they are really doing today.

missions.title: Teach One SDG
missions.description: Explain one Sustainable Development Goal to a friend or family member.

missions.title: 25-Min Focus Session
missions.description: Spend 25 distraction-free minutes learning something new.

missions.title: Equality Shoutout
missions.description: Share a positive message about equality or inclusion.

missions.title: Include Someone New
missions.description: Invite someone who is often left out to join a game, call, or activity.

missions.title: Pick Up 5 Pieces of Litter
missions.description: Pick up at least 5 pieces of litter in a safe public space.

missions.title: Positive Comments Only
missions.description: Only leave positive, kind, or constructive comments online today.

missions.title: Send a Gratitude Note
missions.description: Thank a teacher, driver, cleaner, or community worker today.

missions.title: Go on a Nature Walk
missions.description: Spend at least 15 minutes outside observing nature. Note or photo what you see.

missions.title: Protect Local Water
missions.description: Ensure you leave no waste near water areas. Pick up safe litter if possible.

missions.title: Plant Something
missions.description: Plant a seed, plant, or help care for one—even indoors.

missions.title: Do a Mission With Someone
missions.description: Invite a friend or family member to complete a mission with you.

missions.title: Share Your Action
missions.description: Share or write about one action you took today and why it matters.

missions.title: Donate Something Useful
missions.description: Find one item in good condition – clothes, a book or a toy – and set it aside to donate to a charity or shelter.

missions.title: Learn Why Poverty Happens
missions.description: Read or watch something short about one cause of poverty, then explain it to someone in one sentence.

missions.title: Support a Local Fundraiser
missions.description: Find out about a food drive, fundraiser or charity event near you and share it with your family or friends.

missions.title: Clean Plate Challenge
missions.description: Serve yourself only what you will eat at every meal today, so no food goes in the bin.

missions.title: Use the Leftovers
missions.description: Help make one meal or snack today from leftovers already in the fridge.

missions.title: Food Bank Shopping List
missions.description: Find out what your local food bank needs most and write a short list to share with your family.

missions.title: Thank a Worker
missions.description: Say a real thank-you to someone whose work helps you – a bus driver, cleaner, cook or shop worker.

missions.title: Spot a Fair-Trade Label
missions.description: Look for a fair-trade or ethical label on products at home or in a shop and learn what it means.

missions.title: Practise a Future Skill
missions.description: Spend 20 minutes practising a skill you might use in a job one day – typing, coding, cooking or a language.

missions.title: Learn a Repair
missions.description: Watch a short tutorial and learn how to fix something simple, like a loose button or a bike chain.

missions.title: Invent a Solution
missions.description: Sketch an idea for an invention that could solve a problem in your school or neighbourhood.

missions.title: Help Someone Get Online
missions.description: Help a family member or neighbour with something online they find tricky, like a video call.

missions.title: Share the Chores
missions.description: Do a household chore today that someone else usually does, so the work is shared more fairly.

missions.title: Learn About an Inspiring Woman
missions.description: Read about a woman who changed science, sport, politics or the arts, and tell someone about her.

missions.title: Disagree Kindly
missions.description: When you disagree with someone today, listen first and explain your view calmly without insults.

missions.title: Learn Your Rights
missions.description: Read about one of the rights in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child and what it means for you.

missions.title: Skip Single-Use Plastic
missions.description: Avoid single-use plastic today – no straws, plastic cutlery or plastic bags.

missions.title: Share an Ocean Fact
missions.description: Learn one surprising fact about ocean life or ocean pollution and share it with a friend.

missions.title: Learn About Another Culture
missions.description: Learn about a tradition, food or festival from a culture different from your own.

missions.title: Stand Up for Someone
missions.description: If you see someone being left out or treated unfairly today, speak up or include them.

missions.title: Use Natural Light
missions.description: Keep the lights off during daylight hours and open curtains or blinds instead.

missions.title: Read for 20 Minutes
missions.description: Read a book, article or comic for 20 minutes just for fun.

missions.title: Make an SDG Poster
missions.description: Create a small poster or post about one SDG and display or share it.

missions.title: Make Space for Wildlife
missions.description: Leave a small wild corner, put out water for birds or build a simple bug hotel.

missions.title: Do a Home Energy Check
missions.description: Walk around your home and count devices left on standby, then switch off the ones that can be.

missions.title: Take Public Transport
missions.description: Use a bus, train or tram instead of a car for one trip today.

impactNote: Impact amounts are rough, conservative per-action estimates for awareness, not measurements.
